lead: The lower part of El Guinardó, next to the Recinte Modernista de Sant Pau and the Parc de les Aigües.
text: This is the part of El Guinardó closest to the Eixample, with the Recinte Modernista de Sant Pau, designed by Lluís Domènech i Montaner, and the Parc de les Aigües as its great landmarks. Here you will also find Can Móra, the current seat of the Horta-Guinardó district, and the Guinardó-Mercè Rodoreda library.

With 26,277 inhabitants in 0.56 km², it is a dense and lived-in neighbourhood, with local shops and good connections to the Eixample and the Sagrada Família. Its sale price, 4,160 €/m², is one of the highest in Horta-Guinardó.
housing: Blocks of flats from different periods, in the area closest to the Eixample.
